description: This file defines a REST controller for managing passenger data, providing CRUD endpoints for creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting passenger profiles in a Java Spring Boot application.

classes.name: PassengerController
classes.description: REST controller exposing CRUD endpoints for Passenger objects.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns a list of all passengers.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a passenger by UUID, throws NotFoundException if not found.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new passenger from the request data and returns the created entity.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing passenger with the provided fields.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a passenger by UUID if exists.
